title: Without Reports page access the six reports are not available
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-B}, whose custom role {Role-A} has every permission except "Reports → Page Access".
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-14 No Reports with the custom role ZZAUTOTEST S1-14 No Reports Role.
  • You have a link to A/R Summary and a link to A/P Detail, copied earlier from the address bar by an Admin user.
  • Starting screen: the ShopView home page in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click Reports in the top menu and read the left menu's ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE and ACCOUNTS PAYABLE sections.
  2. Paste the A/R Summary link into the address bar and press Enter.
  3. Paste the A/P Detail link into the address bar and press Enter.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: none of the six reports is offered (on screen: "A/R Aging Summary", "A/R Aging Detail", "A/R Aging Collection", "A/P Aging Summary", "A/P Aging Detail", "A/P Unpaid Invoices"), as today.
  • Step 2: the report does not open, as today for a user without this permission.
  • Step 3: the report does not open, as today.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order)

  • S1-N1: “If the user lacks 'Reports → Page Access', the reports are not available, as today.”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “Permissions. Viewing all six reports, and exporting them, is governed by 'Reports → Page Access', unchanged. No new permission is introduced and no existing permission changes. Opening a document from a report uses the permission that already opens that document (see Story 7). The credit term on the A/R Collection call list follows the customer card's rule: only users with the 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' switch see it, on screen, in the PDF and in the CSV (Story 9). Amounts show to everyone who can open the reports, as today and as on Sales By Customer and Inventory Value; 'See Financial Data' does not hide them.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 1 "Opening order and header sorting" (board Main.dc.html). The design draws no picture of this behaviour (all 7 boards and 45 figures checked); the case follows the PRD.
